reference_sql:
SELECT
              ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price * (1 - o.discount)), 4) AS revenue,
              ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_cost), 4) AS cost
            FROM orders o
            JOIN products p USING (product_id)
            JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
            WHERE p.category = 'sensor' AND c.region = 'north'
              AND o.status = 'completed' AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2024
              AND o.order_id >= 1

),
total_orders_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        COUNT(*) as total_orders
    FROM sensor_orders_2024
    GROUP BY region
),
refunded_orders_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        so.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT so.order_id) as refunded_orders
    FROM sensor_orders_2024 so
    JOIN refunds r ON so.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY so.region
)
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.total_orders,
    COALESCE(r.refunded_orders, 0) as refunded_orders,
    CASE WHEN t.total_orders > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.refunded_orders, 0) * 100.0 / t.total_orders ELSE 0 END as refund_rate
FROM total_orders_by_region t
LEFT JOIN refunded_orders_by_region r ON t.region = r.region
ORDER BY t.region
